# Copperfield Precision Tooling - Shift Production & Staffing Plan
Line B Machining & Assembly - Week 11 (03/16/2026 - 03/20/2026)

## Weekly Production Targets & Capacity
| Cell | Work Order | Target Units | Planned Runtime (hrs) | Standard Rate (units/hr) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CNC Lathe 1 | WO-8841 | 1,200 | 40 | 30 |
| CNC Mill 3 | WO-8842 | 800 | 40 | 20 |
| Deburr & Wash | WO-8841/42 | 2,000 | 40 | 50 |
| Pack & Crate | WO-8841/42 | 2,000 | 40 | 50 |

## Shift Staffing Assignments
- First Shift Supervisor: Gordon Banerjee (06:00 to 14:30)
- CNC Mill 3 Primary Operator: Andre Lindqvist (Certified Level II Mill)
- CNC Lathe 1 Primary Operator: Lucas Osei (Certified Level II Lathe)
- Wash & Finishing Operator: Brenda Navarro (Certified Level I General)
- Pack & Crate Handler: Darryl Evans (Certified Material Handler)

## Operational Sequence & Safety Directives
- CNC Mill 3 will run WO-8842 with 200 units per shift target across 40 hours total.
- Material staging for Lathe 1 must be completed 15 minutes prior to shift startup.
- Operators on Lathe 1 must wear Level 3 cut-resistant gloves and side-shield eye protection.
- Scheduled maintenance: Mill 3 spindle flush is assigned on Wednesday at 13:00.
- Mandatory zero-energy verification before manual chip bin removal on Mill 3 and Lathe 1.

errors.quote: CNC Mill 3 will run WO-8842 with 200 units per shift target across 40 hours total.
errors.explanation: The table specifies a target of 800 units over 40 hours (five 8-hour shifts), which equals 160 units per shift (or 20 units/hour x 8 hours), not 200 units per shift.
errors.fix: CNC Mill 3 will run WO-8842 with 160 units per shift target across 40 hours total.

errors.quote: Mandatory zero-energy verification before manual chip bin removal on Mill 3 and Lathe 1.
errors.explanation: OSHA Lockout/Tagout standard 29 CFR 1910.147 requires formal lockout/tagout (LOTO) isolation, not merely a zero-energy check, before operators clear or pull scrap and chip bins inside machine enclosures.
errors.fix: Mandatory lockout/tagout isolation and zero-energy verification before manual chip bin removal on Mill 3 and Lathe 1.
